text:
Alex: hey infra team, prepping a capacity request for southafricanorth — need help pulling together quota numbers and opening the Azure support ticket :wave:
Jordan: what SKUs and counts are you aiming for? also subscription and ETA pls
Alex: target SKUs: ND96as_v4 (inference rigs) x8, NC24s_v3 (batch) x12. timeline: deploy window 2026-04-15 to 2026-04-30, soft launch on 04/20. subscription: sub-0a1b2c3d (prod-gpu). cost center: infra-ai.
Maya: noted, I'll open the Azure SR after we confirm networking limits (public IP / vnet NIC quotas cause the usual snags).
Liam: FYI cluster autoscaler needs extra spare IPs for scale-up — current IP quota is 200 per subscription in SA North by default. we'll probably need 400. also NIC-per-vm quota check: some NC skus need 8 NICs on our VM sizes.
Priya: +1 on NIC and IP checks. also need to confirm Accelerated Networking SKU support in that region for ND96as_v4 or fallback to ND96as_v3.
Alex: quick check command I ran:
```
az vm list-usage --location "southafricanorth" --subscription sub-0a1b2c3d
# look for: "Total Regional vCPUs" and "Public IP Addresses" and specific sku usage
```
Output snip:
```
"name": "Public IP Addresses",
"currentValue": 186,
"limit": 200
```
so we only have ~14 free public IPs left.
Jordan: OK looks tight. Requested increases:
- Public IPs -> 500
- ND96as_v4 quota -> 10 (start with 8 but ask cushion)
- NC24s_v3 quota -> 20
- NICs per subscription -> 2000 (or remove per-sku throttle)
I'll add justification (production inference, predictable latency SLA) in the SR.
Maya: opening SR now. tagging subscription owners and cost center. SR details:
- SR#: SR12094567
- Severity: Standard (we can escalate if AZ asks for details)
- Summary: Increase Public IP, ND96as_v4 and NC24s_v3 quota for subscription sub-0a1b2c3d in South Africa North for inference rollout
Azure SR link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade/srid/SR12094567
devops-bot: Azure SR SR12094567 created by Maya and assigned to Azure Support (initial response ETA ~ 24h).
Liam: after SR opened, please request PG (product group) review for ND96as_v4 — those SKUs are capacity constrained in that region, may require a capacity reservation (reservation request) rather than just quota bump.
Maya: added note to SR: "Please advise if capacity reservation (hold) is required for ND96as_v4 for dates 2026-04-15 -> 2026-04-30. Contact: Alex (eng), Jordan (infra)."
Jordan: I'm going to update the internal tracker (sheet) with SR# and tentative reservation ask. linking to runbook for reservation request: https://docs.internal/redwood/infra/azure/reservations
Priya: small networking gotcha: Azure enforces per-VNet / per-subnet lower port ranges for UDP NAT translation for outbound SNAT—our inference nodes open many outbound connections to telemetry endpoints; we should ask network team for a dedicated NAT gateway and a larger SNAT pool.
Alex: noted, add NAT Gateway + standard SKU to request and estimate monthly cost. ballpark cost increase ~ $1.2k/mo for NAT gateway + static public IPs.
Maya: Azure replied initial acknowledgement. they asked for a contact phone number and to confirm if there's a strict launch date. I sent: +1-555-0142 and confirmed 2026-04-20 soft launch.
devops-bot: Azure update pushed to SR12094567: "Escalated to Capacity PG for SA North — investigating ND96as_v4 availability and reservation process" :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jordan: great. action items:
- Alex: share exact VM SKU list and expected per-node NIC/IP needs
- Liam: prepare cluster autoscaler patch to set max surge and graceful eviction to avoid flappy nodes if quota delayed
- Priya: draft NAT Gateway justification
- Maya: follow up with Azure in 12h if no update
Alex: will drop a short spec in this thread by EOD with SKU manifest and per-node network demand.
Liam: also attaching recent kube-proxy logs we saw when we hit IP exhaustion last month (for context):
```
I0402 10:12:34.123 kube-proxy: failed to allocate service IP: no available addresses
```
that caused rolling failures for ~15min. we want to avoid repeat.
Maya: SR updated with network + reservation notes. Azure asked us to confirm if we can accept alternative SKUs (ND96as_v3) if v4 not available; I said we prefer v4 but can accept v3 with 10% perf delta and request guidance on pricing impact.
Alex: thanks all. I'll post the SKU manifest and expected token throughput per node (for batching config) shortly. please react with :thumbsup: when you add your tasks to the tracker.
Jordan: added tasks and pinged infra owners in the ops calendar to block 2026-04-13 -> 2026-04-21 for validation.
Maya: keeping thread updated with SR notes. will escalate to P1 if Azure asks for firm launch commitment.
Priya: adding NAT gateway cost to the infra estimate spreadsheet.
devops-bot: Reminder: update internal reservation tracker: https://sheets.internal/redwood/azure-reservations (entry created: SR12094567, sub-0a1b2c3d, requested 2026-04-15..2026-04-30).
Alex: closing for now, will post manifest. cheers. :coffee:
